tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Check if a single email address is real and deliverable. Runs syntax, domain/MX, disposable, role-account, live SMTP mailbox, catch-all, SPF/DMARC and typo checks, and returns status (valid / invalid / risky / unknown), a 0-100 confidence score, reasons and a did_you_mean suggestion for likely typos

tools.name: verify_email_batch
tools.description: Verify up to 50 email addresses in one call (for example a lead list before an outreach campaign). Returns a count per status (valid / invalid / risky / unknown) and the full result for each address. Duplicates are checked once. For larger lists, split into several calls.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_email_batch · Public sink: verify_email, verify_email_batch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email, verify_email_batch · Public sink: verify_email, verify_email_batch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
